display-width stays in-tree rather than adding a new core runtime dependency; the width primitive now owns ANSI/OSC-8 transparent clipping and padding.

Artifact polish belongs in the shared distribution theme so PRD, decision, research, and generic PDF exports improve together and can be regression-tested through the normal publish path.

Orchestration readiness is an observed attachment contract, separate from descriptive execution planning; `orchestration_readiness`/`construct orchestrate preflight` verify tool reachability and return typed recovery reasons.
